chunks: "If the people knew what is in the siwak, they would surely keep it with them in their bedding."

key_terms.السِّوَاكِ: the tooth-stick used for cleaning the mouth
key_terms.لِحَافٍ: bedding or covering used for sleep

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the virtue and benefit of the siwak?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the great benefit and importance of the siwak. It encourages constant care for oral cleanliness by portraying the siwak as something so beneficial that people would keep it close even at night.
